note: Weight and stack size come from the game files. Where to find it was written by hand and not checked.

name: Torch
hoardNote: A tool you need to own.
description: It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness.

name: Bracelets of the Brave
description: Your mind hardens, as do your blows.

name: Evasion Mantle
description: Dance with death as you dodge your enemies' strikes.

name: Heart of the Forest
description: It pulsates with fragments of ancient life.

name: Bronze Pendant
description: A beautiful pendant, harbouring the endurance of a bear.

name: Iron Brooch
description: A delicate yet defensive accessory.

name: Wolf Sight
description: Assume the sharp and furious mind of a wolf.

name: Crystal Heart
description: A shard of frozen sorrow. Touching it makes you feel almost numb.

name: Troll Hide
description: A thick and sturdy hide. This is why trolls are so hard to kill.

name: Abomination Trophy
description: A tangled mess of roots and bark.

name: Bear Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Bronze Pendant, crafting Headdress of the Bear. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: That stare is still frightening...

name: Blob Trophy
description: A smelly lump of sticky matter.

name: Boar Trophy
description: This boar head would make for a nice decoration in any house.

name: Bonemass Trophy
description:
Bones and viscous goo, held together by some unseen force.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

name: Cultist Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Fenris Hood. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: My, what big teeth it has...

name: Deathsquito Trophy
description: You don't like touching this thing even when it's dead.

name: Deer Trophy
hoardNote: Needed to summon Eikthyr.
description: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla.

name: Moder Trophy
description:
The head of a dragon, majestic even in the rigor of death.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

name: Draugr Trophy
description: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...

name: Draugr Elite Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Iron Sledge. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones.

name: Eikthyr Trophy
description:
This severed head oozes power.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

name: Fenring Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Wolf Sight. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: A strange, elongated paw, its claws razor sharp.

name: Troll Trophy
description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.

name: Fuling Trophy
description: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes.

name: Fuling Berserker Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Evasion Mantle. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder.

name: Yagluth Trophy
description:
The crownless head of a dead king.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

name: Fuling Shaman Trophy
description: It shall cast no more spells against you.

name: Greydwarf Trophy
description: The mossy, severed head of a Greydwarf.

name: Greydwarf Brute Trophy
description: It took seven blows to hack this gnarled head from its body.

name: Greydwarf Shaman Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Heart of the Forest. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots...

name: Drake Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Drake Helmet. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: Still cold to the touch.

name: Leech Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Iron Brooch. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black.

name: Lox Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Bracelets of the Brave. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur.

name: Neck Trophy
description: The beady eyes and razor sharp teeth belie the ostensibly calm nature of this small lizard.

name: Stone Golem Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Crystal Heart. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration.

name: Skeleton Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Bone Tower Shield. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death.

name: The Elder Trophy
description:
This severed head oozes power.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

name: Wolf Trophy
hoardNote: Used for crafting Wolf Fur Cape. Quantity is the largest single need.
description: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat.

name: Wraith Trophy
description: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight.

name: Writhan Trophy
description: Tough dead, it should probably be handled delicately.

name: Turnip
hoardNote: Used for building Spice Rack, crafting Black Soup, crafting Turnip Stew. Quantity is the largest single need.

obtainedFrom.node: Grow from Turnip Seeds.

description: A dense vegetable, rich with nutrition.
note: Weight and stack size come from the game files. Where to find it was written by hand and not checked.

name: Turnip Seeds

obtainedFrom.node: Pick wild turnips in the Swamp (guides), or collect seeds when harvesting grown ones.

description: These can be planted in cultivated soil.
note: Weight and stack size come from the game files. Where to find it was written by hand and not checked.

name: Turnip Stew
description: Nutritious and restorative.

name: Wishbone
description: This ancient bone remembers the location of many forgotten things.
use: Equip it to find silver: it reacts when you are close to a silver vein in the Mountains. Mine the vein with a pickaxe.
